items.title: CVE-2026-94107 — HIGH
items.summary: NivoCart through 2.4.0 contains a predictable password reset token vulnerability in the forgotten.php endpoint that generates recovery codes using substr(md5(mt_rand()), 0, 10). Attackers who know an administrator's email address can request a password reset and predict the token to gain administrative account access without rate limiting or expiration.

items.title: CVE-2026-94106 — HIGH
items.summary: getID3 before 1.9.26 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in shell-out handlers that fail to escape filenames in command strings. Attackers can craft malicious filenames containing shell metacharacters to inject arbitrary commands executed with the privileges of the process embedding getID3.

items.title: CVE-2026-94104 — HIGH
items.summary: NivoCart through 2.4.0 contains an arbitrary file upload vulnerability in the File Manager multi() endpoint that fails to validate file extensions for new filenames or when chunks parameter is 2 or higher. Attackers with view-only back-office access can upload PHP files to the web-accessible image/data/ directory and execute them for remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-94004 — HIGH
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in DedeCMS up to 5.7.118. The affected element is an unknown function of the file plus/mytag_js.php. The manipulation of the argument aid results in code injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-94003 — CRITICAL
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in Comfast CF-N1-S 2.6.0.1. Impacted is the function get_css_path_from_uri of the file /cgi-bin/mbox-config of the component Web Management Interface. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
